name: Sofia Herrera
bio:
Sofia's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood in Buenos Aires, attending local races with her father. She channeled her analytical mind into motorsport strategy, excelling in simulated racing environments before transitioning to real-world applications. Her sharp decision-making and keen understanding of race dynamics quickly made her a valuable asset to smaller racing teams. 

Sofia's approach is data-driven, meticulously analyzing telemetry and competitor performance to identify optimal race strategies. She believes in proactive planning and contingency scenarios, ensuring the team is prepared for any situation. Her drive and ambition are matched only by her dedication to achieving race-winning results. She is known for pushing the boundaries of strategic thinking, always seeking an edge through innovative approaches and calculated risks.

What sets Sofia apart is her ability to translate complex data into easily understandable directives for the driver and pit crew. She fosters a collaborative environment where every team member understands their role in executing the strategy to perfection. Her demanding nature pushes the team to perform at their best under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair pulled back into a high ponytail
physical.description: Sofia has a athletic build and sharp, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Drinks mate tea constantly throughout race weekends.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when under pressure or deep in thought.
